caption: Bend readings travel from the glove sensors to a single gesture event. Notice that per-user calibration sits between digitising and classification, that segmentation and feature extraction come before classification, and that the last step is a threshold with hysteresis, not one raw reading.

spec.title: Data glove to gesture event
spec.aria: Pipeline that carries bend readings from glove sensors through digitising, calibration, segmentation and classification to a single gesture event.
